answer: Bind each key to one person, anonymously. A key earns only by proving in zero knowledge that it holds a government eID chip, and publishing a nullifier: the document secret hashed with this domain. The registry refuses any nullifier it has seen: one document, one key, forever, no name on the ledger. A thousand keys cost a thousand people, and a bought document burns once: supply, not price, is the wall. A forged shell holds no walnut; each document is an opal, refracting once. Money is the trellis, people the vine. Boundary: rented documents make cost a wage, so co-holders carry the slash.
